Homemade Baking Mix
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 11:19pm

Ingredients




3 cups Whole wheat flour
7 cups All purpose flour
6 tablespoons Baking pwder
1 1/2 tablespoons Salt
1 1/2 teaspoons Cream of tartar
2 cups Shortening
2 cups Instant nonfat dry milk

Preparation

1 1. Mix together flours, baking powder, salt, cream of tartar and sugar. 2 2. With pastry cutter cut in shortening until the mixture is the consistency of cornmeal. Gently stir in the dry milk. 3 3. Store in tight container in cool place. 4 Yields 4 lbs.
